name: Secret Rotation Validator

# Triggers:
#  - push / pull_request: validate secrets on every change to the config or code
#  - schedule: a daily cron so expiring secrets are surfaced even with no commits
#  - workflow_dispatch: lets operators run the report on demand (with overrides)
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *" # every day at 08:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      warning_days:
        description: "Warning window in days"
        required: false
        default: "14"

# Least-privilege: the job only needs to read the repository contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Defaults shared across steps. NOW is pinned so report output is
# deterministic in CI; override SECRETS_FILE / WARNING_DAYS as needed.
env:
  SECRETS_FILE: fixtures/secrets.json
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}
  NOW: "2026-06-27"

jobs:
  test:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: bun test

  validate:
    name: Validate secret rotation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test # only validate once the unit tests pass
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json > report.json
          cat report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: bun run scripts/summarize.ts report.json

      - name: Add report to job summary
        run: cat report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rotation-report
          path: |
            report.json
            report.md
          if-no-files-found: error

name: Secret Rotation Validator

# Triggers:
#  - push / pull_request: validate secrets on every change to the config or code
#  - schedule: a daily cron so expiring secrets are surfaced even with no commits
#  - workflow_dispatch: lets operators run the report on demand (with overrides)
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *" # every day at 08:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      warning_days:
        description: "Warning window in days"
        required: false
        default: "14"

# Least-privilege: the job only needs to read the repository contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Defaults shared across steps. NOW is pinned so report output is
# deterministic in CI; override SECRETS_FILE / WARNING_DAYS as needed.
env:
  SECRETS_FILE: fixtures/secrets.json
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}
  NOW: "2026-06-27"

jobs:
  test:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: bun test

  validate:
    name: Validate secret rotation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test # only validate once the unit tests pass
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json > report.json
          cat report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: bun run scripts/summarize.ts report.json

      - name: Add report to job summary
        run: cat report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Secret Rotation Validator

# Triggers:
#  - push / pull_request: validate secrets on every change to the config or code
#  - schedule: a daily cron so expiring secrets are surfaced even with no commits
#  - workflow_dispatch: lets operators run the report on demand (with overrides)
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *" # every day at 08:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      warning_days:
        description: "Warning window in days"
        required: false
        default: "14"

# Least-privilege: the job only needs to read the repository contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Defaults shared across steps. NOW is pinned so report output is
# deterministic in CI; override SECRETS_FILE / WARNING_DAYS as needed.
env:
  SECRETS_FILE: fixtures/secrets.json
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}
  NOW: "2026-06-27"

jobs:
  test:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Run unit tests
        # Only the pure-logic TDD suites run inside CI. The meta suites
        # (act harness, actionlint structure checks) require Docker/act and
        # actionlint, which are not present inside the runner container, so
        # they are excluded here to avoid recursive/unavailable tooling.
        run: bun test tests/validator.test.ts tests/report.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts

  validate:
    name: Validate secret rotation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test # only validate once the unit tests pass
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json > report.json
          cat report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          bun run src/cli.ts \
            --input "$SECRETS_FILE" \
            --warning "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: bun run scripts/summarize.ts report.json

      - name: Add report to job summary
        run: cat report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
